purpose: One registry for composable bounded transformations across UI, agents, HOUSE/HAOS and physical return. Preserve mechanisms; do not create parallel pipelines.

lineage.rule: Recover donor semantics; current registry is a new composition layer, not a claim that historical code implemented current behavior.

laws: IDENTITY survives projection unless a declared transform creates a new object.
OBSERVATION may refine a candidate default; it may not grant authority.
COMPOSITION preserves each member's authority ceiling.
NO RECURSION WITHOUT DELTA OR NEW EVIDENCE.
A failed/ambiguous transform returns residue instead of silently selecting another goal.
Consequential external action requires explicit or pre-delegated bounded authority.
SUPPORT=0 remains inspectable; support is possibility evidence, never authority.
Typed composition rejects an incompatible next transform instead of silently coercing to a nearest state.

transductions.commit: artifact + RETURN when pass criteria hold

transductions.focus: explicit scale + position inside the source
transductions.transform: project whole source into addressed focus without replacing canonical source
transductions.commit: none; focus is reversible view state
transductions.evidence: focus scale + index + address; payload remains session-local
transductions.reversibility: instant WHOLE/FOCUS switch or aperture movement

transductions.source: current Port route scope (whole or focus)
transductions.transform: count explicit lexical cues + derive low-risk likely route
transductions.observable: per-route cue counts + LIKELY suggestion; zero-support routes stay available
transductions.evidence: cue counts + candidate accept/override + content-free route receipt
transductions.note: HUMAN PORT 1.5 separates structural FIT from heuristic CUES and local HISTORY; retain as provenance only.

transductions.source: addressed object + current projection contract + ordered LensState stack
transductions.focus: one candidate VIEW_LENS or ACTION_TOOLGLASS descriptor
transductions.transform: evaluate inputContract against current ordered output contract; expose support=1 or support=0 + reason; compose only when supported
transductions.commit: VIEW_LENS: none / preview only; ACTION_TOOLGLASS: only with explicit COMMIT authority and receipt
transductions.observable: ordered projection stack + current contract + lawful/dead next candidates
transductions.evidence: LensState serialization + support result + sourceRefs + returnAddress; CI law receipt
transductions.authority: VIEW_ONLY unless an explicit ACTION_TOOLGLASS declares bounded COMMIT authority
transductions.reversibility: uncompose/RETURN for view state; consequential rollback is compensating RETURN, never history erasure

transductions.transform: exact contract lookup → DIRECT / ADAPTER / NONE
transductions.observable: structural ability of a route to consume this projection

transductions.evidence: cue count only; never called confidence

compositions.note: Preference evidence tunes presentation only; no authority escalation.
May repeat only under an explicit bounded recurrence contract; otherwise stop after one consequential delta.
HUMAN PORT 1.5: one addressed object survives unequal projections. FIT/CUES/HISTORY remain separate; authority is never derived from them. FIELD INTAKE is the reviewed admission boundary.

One FIELD route identity survives AXIAL selection, aperture/projection changes and Studio handoff. AXIAL source-support and Lens type-support remain distinct calculations under the shared law that dead states stay visible and support never grants authority.

instrument_cell.purpose: One self-contained addressed instrument that can be rendered through unequal lawful projections without creating another source of truth.
laws: A projection cell never owns source identity.
Changing projection, scale, orientation or fold state must preserve canonical identity unless an explicit transform declares a new object.
Operator semantics must be visible from the instrument state; hidden global mode is a last resort.
Composition is ordered and inspectable; the user must be able to tell which lenses/operators are active.
View composition may fuse away intermediate renderings, but provenance and RETURN remain recoverable.
A physical fold, rotation, detent or gesture changes semantics only when an explicit mapping says what changed.
Six sectors are a useful carrier, not a universal ontology.
A projection may suppress a declared channel; suppression becomes explicit residue and may not erase host truth.
Single focus and multifocus are shared instrument state; hosts do not need parallel selection stores to participate.

projection_cells.changes: coordinate only unless host declares cyclic semantics

projection_cells.candidate_reading: stateful adjacency exposed by physical or simulated folding
projection_cells.changes: projection; topology only when explicitly declared

projection_cells.candidate_reading: orientation + typed ports around an addressed object
temporal aperture over one canonical address stream

rosette6.geometry: center + six sectors/petals; flat polygon/radial view may fold into a 3D carrier
rosette6.center: current invariant / intent / exact focus, host-defined
rosette6.sectors: six host-defined facets, operators or inputs
controls: fold = reveal/hide/change adjacency only when declared
press/click/gesture = operate through the currently visible sector
commit remains separately visible when consequence can become durable
rosette6.recovered_preset_note: F.L.O.W.E.R. and FU six-way semantics are donors/presets, not mandatory global labels.

browser_extension.surface: generic DOM; host-specific semantics remain adapter-owned

artifact_fold.goal: Reduce active sovereign artifacts without deleting evidence. Exact historical artifacts remain addressable; overlapping heads become aliases, host adapters or projection recipes when their unique semantics round-trip through the canonical instrument.
lossless_test: same canonical source identity is recoverable
aperture/scale and active parameters are recoverable
operator semantics and ordering are recoverable
any domain-specific behavior not represented above remains in the host and is not silently discarded

folds.result: One mechanism with unequal host vocabularies; do not maintain these geometries as separate ontologies.
Projection recipes are inventory cells, not sovereign applications.
Retain each recovered semantic preset as a named preset; share one carrier grammar. The exact remembered key-shaped/six-panel historical artifact remains UNKNOWN until directly recovered.

artifact_fold.demotion_rule: A folded artifact may leave the active surface/showcase only after a round-trip fixture proves its unique state can be reconstructed from canonical source + instrument state + projection recipe. Demotion is not deletion.
artifact_fold.refusal_rule: If unique semantics, authority, source bytes, authored marks, physical topology or return evidence cannot round-trip, the artifact is not foldable yet.

proof_state.model: SPIKE 003 proves one heterogeneous state survives LINE / FLOWER_KEY / RADIAL / ROOM / GLYPH with explicit residue.
proof_state.runtime: INTERPHASE 0.2 binds FIELD, READFIELD, Scale Lens, LISTEN and generic DOM through one host protocol.
proof_state.rule: Demotion still requires lived use and unique-residue review; implementation proof does not authorize bulk deletion.
